subject: Refer to a local file in shinydashboard

messages.author: ff9f3798f843eb7d
messages.subject: Refer to a local file in shinydashboard
parts:
Hi - I had dashboard that works great locally. The problem when i want to deploy it is that all my data sources are in my C drive.

I am not sure how to refer to a local file. I have seen many code examples and all refer to a sever somewhere.

Is it possible to referrer to a local file ?


library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)
require(htmltools)

indicators <- read.csv ("C:/Users/user1/Desktop/devices.csv")

Cheers,

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Refer to a local file in shinydashboard
parts:
Blas,

You should use a relative path to reference your data files. The path should be relative to your ui.R server.R files.

For example:

If your application directory structure is:

myappdir\
myappdir\server.R
myappdir\ui.R
myappdir\devices.csv

You can reference data files by doing

read.csv('devices.csv')
On Fri, May 1, 2015 at 5:04 AM, Blas Prieto <priet...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi - I had dashboard that works great locally. The problem when i want to deploy it is that all my data sources are in my C drive.

I am not sure how to refer to a local file. I have seen many code examples and all refer to a sever somewhere.

library(shiny)

Cheers,
